newsitem.title: USA: Servico files for 10 million common shares.
newsitem.headline: Servico files for 10 million common shares.

text.p: Servico Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to 10 million common shares.
Of the total amount, eight million shares are being offered by the company in the United States and Canada, while two million common shares are being offered elsewhere.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 19,396,405 common, the company said in the filing.

Net proceeds will be used for repayment of about $128 million in debt, purchase of interests in three hotels held by certain affiliates of the company, working capital and other general corporate purposes.
Servico, based in West Palm Beach, Fla., is an owner and operator of about 59 full-service hotels in the United States.
